# Product Launch

`product-launch` · v1.0.1 · Execute · Growth, Retention & RevOps
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/product-launch/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** How big a launch does this change deserve, is it ready for a date, and what has to happen on which day?

**Inputs:** What is being launched and to whom, whether it changes pricing or how customers work, a 0-2 score for each of the twelve readiness items, and the launch date if one is set

**Output:** The launch tier with its reasons, a readiness score and verdict with the gaps ranked, a dated work-back plan filtered to the tier, and the launch-day go/no-go gates

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill product-launch`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/product-launch/resources/launch.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/product-launch/resources/launch.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: not recorded yet.

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- Readiness is the team's own 0-2 scores on twelve items, and a missing item scores 0. The engine cannot verify them. The 85% and 60% thresholds are AAJ's, not an industry standard.
- The tier comes from the launch fields you choose. It flags a mismatch with what the team intends only if you give plannedScale.
- The work-back plan marks every task due before today as overdue, whether or not it is done; it is not linked to the gate scores.
- The four launch-day go/no-go gates are listed, not checked. Someone has to confirm each one on the morning.

**Review before acting:** The launch owner checks each readiness score with the person responsible for that item before a date is set, and confirms the four go/no-go gates on the morning before the launch goes out.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/product-launch](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/product-launch)
